root_causes.description: The cart service shows an elevated and ramping container memory working set during the incident window, consistent with an injected memory-stress workload, while request errors remain at zero.

evidence.expected_baseline: flat steady-state working set; comparable service product-catalog ~24.5MB with no in-window ramp

evidence.observed_value: mean=24191249 B, max=24584192 B, flat with no ramp
evidence.expected_baseline: cart working set above this and rising during window

evidence.observed_value: mean=0.000, max=0.000 error rate throughout window

root_causes.description: Secondary effect: cart server-side p99 latency rose well above its median during the window, plausibly driven by memory-pressure-induced stalls.
Cart container shows a restart during the window (restart counter increase plus pod lifecycle Created/Started events), which could be OOM-driven secondary to memory stress.

evidence.observed_value: Container created/Started count=2 for cart pod in otel-demo

remediation_steps: Confirm cart pod memory limit vs working set and check for OOMKilled/restart history (kubectl describe pod -n otel-demo -l app=cart).
If memory_stress is injected (fault seed cart-memory_stress-seed42), stop the memory-stress experiment or raise the cart container memory limit/requests.
Scale cart horizontally and restart the affected cart pod to reclaim memory and clear latency stalls.
Add memory-usage growth-rate alerting and a p99 latency SLO alert for cart to catch recurrence.
